title: Multi-Channel Mitigation of Source-Trust Shortcuts in Fact-Checking RL Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented fact-checkers often receive a reliability label, such as HIGH or LOW trust, for each evidence source. These labels should adjust the model's confidence and its decision to search for more evidence, while the verdict should follow the evidence content. We introduce TrustSwap, a counterfactual test that swaps, lowers, or removes source labels while keeping every evidence text fixed, and measures its three output channels (the verdict, the confidence, and the search decision) separately. Across untrained and RL-trained models at two scales, three datasets, and two prompts, confidence and search respond to the labels as intended in 49 of 50 comparisons, yet a label change alone alters 4-23% of confident verdicts for Qwen3 models and up to 50% for an existing RL-trained fact-checker. translated_title: 事实核查强化学习智能体中来源信任捷径的多通道缓解
translated_abstract: 检索增强的事实核查系统通常会为每个证据来源接收一个可靠性标签，例如高信任（HIGH）或低信任（LOW）。这些标签应当用于调整模型的置信度及其是否搜索更多证据的决策，而最终判定则应依据证据内容。我们提出了TrustSwap，一种反事实测试方法，它在保持所有证据文本不变的情况下，交换、降低或移除来源标签，并分别测量模型的三个输出通道（判定结果、置信度和搜索决策）。在两个规模、三个数据集和两种提示词下，对未训练和经过强化学习训练的模型进行的50组比较中，有49组显示置信度和搜索行为按预期响应标签变化，但仅改变标签就会使Qwen3模型4-23%的高置信度判定发生改变，对现有的一种强化学习训练的事实核查器而言这一比例高达50%。标准的GRPO微调在8B规模的所有六种设置中都加剧了这一捷径。为减少该捷径，我们提出了信任交换增强（TSA），它通过…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出TrustSwap反事实测试方法，揭示了事实核查RL智能体中来源信任标签会不当地改变判定结果这一捷径效应，并提出信任交换增强（TSA）训练方法来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TrustSwap, a counterfactual test revealing that source-trust labels spuriously alter fact-checking verdicts in RL agents, and proposes Trust-Swap Augmentation (TSA) to mitigate this shortcut.
